chunks: And from him, from Abu Zuhayr al-Nahdi, from Adam ibn Ishaq, from some of his companions, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Upon you is the Night Prayer, for it is the tradition of your Prophet and the custom of the righteous before you, and it drives away illness from your bodies."
ai.seo_question: What are the benefits of Salat al-Layl according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes Salat al-Layl as a continuous tradition (da'b) of the righteous, linking spiritual devotion with physical health by describing it as a 'remover of disease' (matradat al-daw'). This reflects the Shia understanding of worship as a holistic remedy for both the soul and the body, rooted in the Prophetic example.
